bolumler.ozet: When a 34-year-old underachiever gets run over by a bus, his story doesn’t end there. Reincarnated in a new world as an infant, Rudy will seize every opportunity to live the life he’s always wanted. Armed with new friends, some freshly acquired magical abilities, and the courage to do the things he’s always dreamed of, he’s embarking on an epic adventure—with all of his past experience intact!

Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him too afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?
Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy's new friend than he thinks?

The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she's pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy's happy family?

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 1: Chapter 11Light Novel Volume 2: Prologue, Chapter 1-2
bolumler.ozet: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he's supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he'll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.

Rudy is officially Eris's tutor, but she doesn't want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.

Eris's 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There's just one problem: Eris can't dance, and she's quickly losing patience with her lessons.

Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.

Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?

bolumler.baslik: The Value of a Life and the First Job
bolumler.wikiTitle: The Value of a Life and the First Job
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd make it to a city. They need to earn money for their journey, and decide to register as adventurers, but Superd like Ruijerd aren't allowed inside. Rudeus has a plan, but how well will it hold up in practice?

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 2: EpilogueLight Novel Volume 3: Chapter 11-14
bolumler.ozet: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End heads out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn't go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy's plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.

bolumler.baslik: The Woman with the Demon Eyes
bolumler.wikiTitle: The Woman with the Demon Eyes
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus and his friends arrive at Wind port, the southernmost port town of the Demon Continent. The three of them attempt to travel to the continent of Millis by boat, but they are charged a tremendous amount of money for the trip because of the presence of the Superd tribe. That night, Hitogami appears in Rudeus' dreams, that was troubled by the lack of funds, and leaves him with some advice. The next day, while Rudeus is strolling through the town, he meets a mysterious girl who is hungry.

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 4: Side Story, Chapter 4-6
bolumler.ozet: Roxy is looking for Rudeus and the others who have disappeared. While searching for clues, Roxy hears rumors of the infamous Dead End, and comes to Wind port with Elinalise and Talhand, acquaintances of Paul. In the meantime, Rudeus and his friends make a deal with the smuggling organization of Gallus, and cross over to the continent of Millis, which they have been longing for on the condition that they free the slaves in the hideout......

bolumler.baslik: No Such Thing As a Free Lunch
bolumler.wikiTitle: No Such Thing As a Free Lunch
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus is captured in the village of the Beast Tribe for a crime he didn't commit. While hoping that Eris and Ruijerd would come and pick him up, Geese (a member of the demon tribe) is thrown into the same prison cell after cheating while gambling. Rudeus explores the possibility of escaping from prison while talking with Geese when suddenly a group of smugglers attack the village.

bolumler.baslik: Slow Life in the Doldia Village
bolumler.wikiTitle: Slow Life in the Doldia Village
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are welcomed into the Doldia village. Eris is delighted to learn that this village is Ghislaine's hometown, but her brother, Gyes, insults her out as a disgrace to the family, and the two have a tiff. While Rudeus and the others are bewildered by the unpredictable situation, Eris is assigned to teach swordsmanship to Gyes's daughter, Minitona. ......

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 4: Chapter 10 Light Novel Volume 5: Chapter 1, 3
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus and his friends arrive at Millicion, the capital of the Holy Land of Millis. As Rudeus decides to stay for a while to raise funds, as he strolls around the city, he finds a child being kidnapped. He follows the kidnappers to save the child, and gets into a fight with them, but it turns out that someone he knows well is involved.

While Rudeus reunites with his father in Millishion, Eris sets out to fulfill her dream of slaying goblins. While at the Adventures’ Guild, however, she encounters Cliff, a conceited young mage who threatens to spoil her adventure.

Although he is reunited with his father, Paul, Rudeus is heartbroken because Zenith, Lilia, Aisha, and Sylphy went missing in the transference incident, and because of the conflict with Paul. Paul, on the other hand, is admonished by Geese and realizes his own mistakes, such as the words he said to Rudeus, and tries to meet his son again to talk. Rudeus summons up his courage and confronts Paul. ......

After reconciling with Paul and parting ways to find the other's family member, Rudeus, Eris and Ruijerd take a ship to the central continent. Meanwhile, Roxie, Elinalise, and Talhand search for the Greyrat family, including Zenith. At the urging of Nokopara, whom she meets again in the city of Rikarisu, Roxy visits the village of the Migurds, her hometown. Roxy is not at peace with the fact that she ran away from home, but will she be reunited with her parents?

After learning the whereabouts of Lilia and Aisha from The "Human God", Rudeus arrives to Latakia, the capital of the Kingdom of Shirone. Rudeus encounters Aisha, who has escaped from the soldiers in the city and rescued her and asks why she was being chased by the soldiers and where Lilia is. He decides to ask Roxy, who is also supposed to be working at the royal palace of Shirone, for help...

bolumler.baslik: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
bolumler.wikiTitle: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
bolumler.ozet: The third prince of Shirone and Pax's brother, Zanoba, appears in front of Rudeus, who has been caught by Pax and confined in a room as bait to lure Roxy. Zanoba takes out an object and asks Rudeus a question. The situation takes an unexpected turn... On the other hand, Eris and Ruijerd hear that Rudeus has been captured and head to the rescue.

After parting ways with Lilia and Aisha, Rudeus and his friends head to their homeland. On their way, they encounter Orsted, the Dragon God, one of the seven great powers. Eris and Ruijerd suddenly change their expressions and begin to tremble. Although they have never met before, Orsted knows Eris, Ruijerd, and even Paul well, but he doesn't seem to know about Rudeus.

Rudeus and his friends have finally returned to the Fittoa territory. However, the village of Buena, his hometown, has become a wasteland, and the town of Roa, where the Boreas family used to live, has become a refugee camp for people caught up in the teleport incident. After reuniting with the butler Alphonse and Ghislaine, and learning about the current situation in the Fittoa territory and the Boreas family, Eris visit Rudeus after thinking alone.

bolumler.baslik: Wake Up, and One Step Forward
bolumler.wikiTitle: Wake Up, and One Step Forward
bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 1:Extra Chapter Light Novel Volume 6:Chapter 13 & Interlude Light Novel Volume 7:Extra Chapter
bolumler.ozet: Suddenly, Eris disappeared, leaving behind a letter. Rudeus thought that he was able to start his life over again and change through various encounters and journeys, but the shock of losing Eris made him withdraw again like he did in his previous life. Just when he is about to give up on everything, the memory of his mother Zenith comes back to his mind. ......

seasons.ozet: A 34-year-old man, jobless, shut-in and NEET. On a certain day, after he got kicked out of the house, met his death in a traffic incident... or so the man thought. The instant he thought that, suddenly he was reincarnated as "Rudeus" in a world of swords and magic. With the piled regret and experience from his previous life, he swears to live his life earnestly this time around.

bolumler.ozet: Rudeus set out to find his mother, Zenith and heads to the northern region of the Central Continent. However, he is still depressed after Eris left him and disappeared. Rudeus, who met Sarah and Suzanne of the adventurer party "Counter Arrow" in a carriage while enroute to the northern land, accompanies Counter Arrow for a Rank A request at the adventurer's guild.

bolumler.baslik: The Forest in the Dead of Night
bolumler.wikiTitle: The Forest in the Dead of Night
bolumler.ozet: In order to search for his mother, Zenith, Rudeus spreads his name under the nickname of "Quagmire" due to his achievements as an adventurer and his proficiency for the spell. One day, he joins Counter Arrow on their mission in Gargau ruins, but a large number of Snow Drakes attacks them.The party is saved by Stepped Leader party lead by Soldat Heckler who were also in the area but after the battle, Soldat angrily approaches Rudeus and his party...

After the incident in which Rudeus saved Sara's life, her interaction towards Rudeus has changed, and the two grew closer together. Sara asks Rudeus to help her in buying a new dagger, so Rudeus goes on a date. The two of them have fun shopping and talking at the bar, and the atmosphere becomes intimate. Even though he is reminded of Eris' departure, Rudeus makes up his mind after hearing Sara's feelings towards him...!

Rudeus, who had become impotent and let out the feelings he had been harbouring, hit it off with Soldat and later accepts his offer to join him so they began to work together. While staying in the town of Pippin, Rudeus is visited by Elinalise, who was once a member of the same party as Paul, Fangs of the Black Wolf, and she as been traveling with Roxy. She gives Rudeus some information about Zenith.

After receiving a letter of invitation and Hitogami's advice, Rudeus decided to enter Ranoa Magic Academy accompanied by Elinalise where unique students called "Special Students" gather. When he arrives at the university, he faces a mock battle with one of the current students as an exam. His opponent is one of the Special Students named Fitts, who is a chantless magic user like Rudeus.

Rudeus continues his studies at Ranoa Magic Academy as he deepens his relationship with Fitts who joins him on investigating the Teleport Incident. At the Academy, there is also Zanoba who considers Rudeus as a doll figurine master asks to learn how to create them so at the advise of Fitts, they go to the slave market looking for someone they can teach Earth Magic for Zanoba, who is struggling to make dolls because of his Miko strength.

bolumler.baslik: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
bolumler.wikiTitle: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 8 Side Story, Chapters 7-8
bolumler.ozet: While Zanoba and Julie are progressing in their doll making, Rudeus remembered the Roxy doll that he once made and now in Zanoba's possession. He asked Zanoba where it is, but the doll was in pieces. Zanoba explains that it was destroyed in a duel between the Beast Race Princesses Rinia and Pursena which causes Rudeus to tremble with anger.

The season of love has arrived...!? Rudeus is asked by a special student Cliff to introduce him to a certain woman. On the other hand, duels for courtships is prevalent during the Beast Race mating season in the autumn, so Linia and Pursena, princesses of the Doldia tribe, shut themselves away in the dormitory to avoid duels. However, for some reason, someone appears who challenges Rudeus to a duel...!?

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 8 Side StoryLight Novel Volume 9 Chapters 5-6
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus and Fits investigates the Fittoa Region Teleport Incident. Since their research indicates that teleportation and summoning are similar, Rudeus consults with Silent Seven Star another Special Student, who specializes in summoning magic at Ranoa Magic Academy, in order to gain knowledge about summoning magic. What is the identity of that person?

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 9 Side Story, Chapters 7-8
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus contiues his research on Teleport and Summoning Magic and begins to cooperate with Nanahoshi, who came from the same world as him, even though she was not reincarnated. Fitz feels a strange bond between them, even though he does not know why and begins to feel depressed. However, Rudeus also begins to have feelings for Fitz, even though he is a man.

Rudeus discovers that Fitz is actually a woman. There are also signs that by touching her body that Rudeus would be cured of her impotence. Rudeus finds hope in Fitz's presence, but since she pretends to be a man, he worries that she might become distant. Then Luke comes to visit...

bolumler.kaynak:
Light Novel Volume 9 Chapter 11: The Final Push 
Side Story: Sylphiette (Part 0)
Light Novel Volume 10 
Chapter 1: Backing
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus finally learns that Fitz is Sylphiette. Sylphy also tells Rudeus about her feelings, and the two are united. Fitts smiles kindly at Rudeus who apologizes for not realizing that she is Sylphy for a long time. Rudeus makes up his mind and visits Ariel with Fitts.

Rudeus is engaged to Sylphy, but he doesn't know the procedure for marriage in this world, so he consults Zanoba and Cliff. When Rudeus hears that his first priority is deciding on a house to live in, he is introduced to a large but cheap property by a real estate agent. It is said to be a haunted property where visitors die mysteriously due to a curse...

In this world, when people get married, they hold a party at their home, so Rudeus prepares for it with Sylphy. And on the day of the party, while Ariel, Zanoba, and other members of Ranoa Magic Academy were in attendance, Elinalise expression seems different than usual. Meanwhile, Rudeus is summoned by Ariel...

Rudeus receives a letter from his father Paul to inform him that he sent Norn and Aisha, his younger sisters to Sharia and to take care of them. Meanwhile, Nanahoshi, who was teleported from the same world as Rudeus to the Human World, continues to research Summoning Magic to return to his original world, but she is becoming increasingly impatient as she cannot complete her research...

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 10 Chapter 12Light Novel Volume 11 Chapters 1-4
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus' younger sisters Norn and Aisha has arrived and begins to stay at the Greyrat House. However, in contrast to the cheerful and energetic Aisha, Norn is shy and withdrawn towards Rudeus... Rudeus, who is at a loss on how to treat his two younger sisters who are complete opposites of each other decides follow Paul's instructions and decides to send them to study at Ranoa Magic Academy, but...

Norn, who started living in the dormitory of Ranoa Magic University, has become a shut-in. Rudeus tries to somehow save Norn by identifying himself with his previous life, and heads to Norn's classroom. Rudeus is shocked by the words he hears from Norn's classmates... Norn, on the other hand, is also worried about how to deal with her older brother Rudeus.

Norn's interaction with Rudeus has improved for the better and has made friends at Ranoa Magic Academy. Rudeus' life with his family and at the academy progresses smoothly. One day, what does Sylphy plan to tell Rudeus...? And what is the content of the letter he receives from a certain person...?

Upon receiving a letter from Geese saying, "Difficulty in rescuing Zenith, seeking help," Rudeus faces the tough choice of leaving behind his pregnant wife, Sylphy, along with his sisters, Norn and Aisha. Despite his inner struggle, Rudeus decides to head to the labyrinth city of Rapan on the Begaritt continent with Elinalise. However, the journey turns out to be even more perilous than he imagined, putting lives at risk.

Upon arriving at the labyrinth city of Rapan, Rudeus and Elinalise quickly find Geese who brings them to Paul and Lilia. Rudeus gently speaks to the exhausted and haggard Paul, who is lamenting he is unable to rescue Zenith. They discuss the conquest of the Teleport Labyrinth where Zenith is supposed to be, but Roxy, who should be there, is nowhere to be found...

bolumler.baslik: Magic Circles of the Sixth Stratum
bolumler.wikiTitle: Magic Circles of the Sixth Stratum
bolumler.yonetim: Akira Nishimori 西森 章, Yasuaki Fujii 藤井康晶
bolumler.rez: Tsuji, Sayaka, 辻紗耶佳,, Ryosuke, Shibuya, 渋谷亮介
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus, Paul and the other members of the Fangs of the Black Wolf party successfully rescues Roxy, who somehow survives alone in the Teleportation Labyrinth for a whole month so they decide to return to the city of Rapan for Roxy to recover. Although he was concerned about Roxy's occasional aloofness, Rudeus enjoyed reminiscing about the past. Three days later, they once again enter the Teleportation Labyrinth and at an increased progress in conquering each of the floors!

bolumler.rez: Chiahe, Chiu, 邱, 家和,, Akiyama, Yasuhiko, 秋山泰彦
bolumler.ozet: Rudeus and his friends are transported to the seventh floor and finally see Zenith! However, a giant Manatite Hydra, the guardian of the Teleport Labyrinth, stands in their way. The Hydra is a legendary creature thought to be extinct, a formidable enemy from the Second Human-Demon Wars!

After a fierce battle with the Manatite Hydra, Rudeus and the others rescued Zenith. The price was Rudeus' left arm and Paul's life. Furthermore, Zenith seemed to have lost her memory that causes Rudeus to be fall into regret and despair after the death of his father Paul. Then Roxy approaches him...

bolumler.rez: Tomoaki, Takatsudo,, Hiroki, Nagashima,, Ryosuke, Shibuya
bolumler.ozet: After six months, Rudeus returns home to where Sylphy and the others are waiting for him. He talks about what happened in the Teleportation Labyrinth, Paul's death, Zenith's condition, and more. He also talks about Roxy... What will Norn, Aisha, and Sylphy's responses be...?

Although Eris is reunited with Rudeus after their battle against Orsted, Eris realizes her own immaturity and decides to leave him. Arriving at the Holy Land of Swords with Ghislaine, Eris declared her intention to defeat the Dragon God Orsted and began training under the Sword God Gal Farion. There, she also meets Nina Farion, a young Sword Saint in training...

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 9 Extra ChapterLight Novel Volume 10 Side Story
bolumler.ozet: Two years have passed since Eris came to the Holy Land of Swords to become a person worthy of Rudeus. Nina, having heard Rudeus' name from Eris, heads to Sharia to confirm his existence. Meanwhile, the Water God Reida and his disciple Isolte arrive at the Holy Land of Swords. Eris, Nina and Isolte end up training together.

Having taken Roxy as his second wife, Rudeus begins a peaceful life with his family, including Sylphiette, their daughter Lucy, his sisters Norn and Aisha, and also returned to Ranoa Magic Academy where Roxy also plans to become a professor at the academy. As Rudeus introduces Roxy to everyone as his wife, Cliff due to being a devout Milis Religion follower, could not accept it...

With the help of Zanoba and Cliff, Rudeus obtained a new left hand, "Zariff's Prosthetic Arm". However, the danger to his family may one day loom again. Driven by the desire to "not lose anyone else," Rudeus continues his research and finally pleads with Roxy to teach him Water King-level Magic.

At the Holy Millis Church, Cliff and Elinalise’s wedding ceremony is held, and Rudeus and his companions shower the couple with blessings. Amidst the celebrations, Rudeus realizes they haven't celebrated Norn and Aisha's tenth birthdays yet. To buy them presents, he hits the town together with Sylphiette and Roxy. And then, at long last, Rudeus's long-cherished wish is finally...

bolumler.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 13, Chapter 10Light Novel Volume 14, Extra Chapter
bolumler.ozet: When Roxy was hired to escort the Princess of Ranoa, Rudeus decided to tag along. There, they crossed paths with the adventurer party "Amazon Ace", who were assigned to share escort duties—and among them was an unexpected face. It was Sara, former member of Counter Arrow, the adventurer party Rudeus used to travel with…! Rudeus managed to exchange a few words with her, but...

At the graduation ceremony of Ranoa Magic Academy, Linia and Pursena attend as graduates. Nanahoshi dedicates herself to her research on Summoning Magic from other worlds, and Norn is invited to join the student council by Ariel. Those around Rudeus are gradually moving on to their next paths. Amidst all this, Nanahoshi makes a proposal to Rudeus...

In order to find out how Zenith could be healed, Rudeus, through Nanahoshi's introduction, was granted an audience with Armored Dragon King Perugius, one of the three heroes of the Laplace Wars and reside in the floating fortress Chaos Breaker. Exuding an overwhelming presence, Perugius listened to Zenith's story and mentioned the name of an unexpected person.

Nanahoshi suddenly vomits blood and collapses at Chaos Breaker. The cause is Drain Syndrome, an ancient sickness thought to have been eradicated 7,000 years ago. As Nanahoshi fell into despair, Rudeus approaches Perugius, offering to do whatever he could to help her. They then set out to find someone who might know something about Drain Syndrome...

bolumler.baslik: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
bolumler.wikiTitle: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
bolumler.ozet: In search of a cure for Drain Syndrome, Rudeus and his companions travels to the Demon Continent and found Kishirika. However, they were taken away along with Kishirika by the royal guard of the Immortal Demon King Atoferatofe, who was after her. Rudeus confronts Atoferatofe and is invited to join her royal guard, but...

Rudeus and his friends manage to defeat Atoferatofe and obtained the Sokas Grass, which is said to be effective against Drain Syndrome. Will Nanahoshi's illness be cured...!? Then, on the night Rudeus returns home for the first time in a while, Hitogami appears and gives him some advice. When Rudeus tries to follow that advice, a mysterious person appears...

"I have come from the future." That is what the old man who suddenly appeared tells Rudeus. As Rudeus stands there in bewilderment, the old man speaks of the cruel and tragic events destined to befall him and of the root cause behind them all.

"Consult Nanahoshi. Send a letter to Eris. Be wary of Hitogami, but do not make an enemy of him." These were the words left behind by the Future Rudeus. Rudeus opened the diary entrusted to him by his older self; within its pages lay the harrowing account of the life his future self had lived—a story that began with the death of Roxy.

Having finished reading the diary of his older self, Rudeus takes action to protect his beloved family and avert a tragic future. While keeping the existence and details of his older self a secret from Sylphiette and Roxy, he warns them that their family could be in danger and also speaks of the existence of "Eris."

After reconciling with Paul and parting ways to find the other's family member, Rudeus, Eris and Ruijerd take a ship to the central continent. Meanwhile, Roxie, Elinalise, and Talhand search for the Greyrat family, including Zenith. At the urging of Nokopara, whom she meets again in the city of Rikarisu, Roxy visits the village of the Migurds, her hometown. Roxy is not at peace with the fact that she ran away from home, but will she be reunited with her parents?

After learning the whereabouts of Lilia and Aisha from The "Human God", Rudeus arrives to Latakia, the capital of the Kingdom of Shirone. Rudeus encounters Aisha, who has escaped from the soldiers in the city and rescued her and asks why she was being chased by the soldiers and where Lilia is. He decides to ask Roxy, who is also supposed to be working at the royal palace of Shirone, for help...

episodes.baslik: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
episodes.wikiTitle: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid
episodes.ozet: The third prince of Shirone and Pax's brother, Zanoba, appears in front of Rudeus, who has been caught by Pax and confined in a room as bait to lure Roxy. Zanoba takes out an object and asks Rudeus a question. The situation takes an unexpected turn... On the other hand, Eris and Ruijerd hear that Rudeus has been captured and head to the rescue.

After parting ways with Lilia and Aisha, Rudeus and his friends head to their homeland. On their way, they encounter Orsted, the Dragon God, one of the seven great powers. Eris and Ruijerd suddenly change their expressions and begin to tremble. Although they have never met before, Orsted knows Eris, Ruijerd, and even Paul well, but he doesn't seem to know about Rudeus.

Rudeus and his friends have finally returned to the Fittoa territory. However, the village of Buena, his hometown, has become a wasteland, and the town of Roa, where the Boreas family used to live, has become a refugee camp for people caught up in the teleport incident. After reuniting with the butler Alphonse and Ghislaine, and learning about the current situation in the Fittoa territory and the Boreas family, Eris visit Rudeus after thinking alone.

episodes.baslik: Wake Up, and One Step Forward
episodes.wikiTitle: Wake Up, and One Step Forward
episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 1:Extra Chapter Light Novel Volume 6:Chapter 13 & Interlude Light Novel Volume 7:Extra Chapter
episodes.ozet: Suddenly, Eris disappeared, leaving behind a letter. Rudeus thought that he was able to start his life over again and change through various encounters and journeys, but the shock of losing Eris made him withdraw again like he did in his previous life. Just when he is about to give up on everything, the memory of his mother Zenith comes back to his mind. ......

Rudeus set out to find his mother, Zenith and heads to the northern region of the Central Continent. However, he is still depressed after Eris left him and disappeared. Rudeus, who met Sarah and Suzanne of the adventurer party "Counter Arrow" in a carriage while enroute to the northern land, accompanies Counter Arrow for a Rank A request at the adventurer's guild.

episodes.baslik: The Forest in the Dead of Night
episodes.wikiTitle: The Forest in the Dead of Night
episodes.ozet: In order to search for his mother, Zenith, Rudeus spreads his name under the nickname of "Quagmire" due to his achievements as an adventurer and his proficiency for the spell. One day, he joins Counter Arrow on their mission in Gargau ruins, but a large number of Snow Drakes attacks them.The party is saved by Stepped Leader party lead by Soldat Heckler who were also in the area but after the battle, Soldat angrily approaches Rudeus and his party...

After the incident in which Rudeus saved Sara's life, her interaction towards Rudeus has changed, and the two grew closer together. Sara asks Rudeus to help her in buying a new dagger, so Rudeus goes on a date. The two of them have fun shopping and talking at the bar, and the atmosphere becomes intimate. Even though he is reminded of Eris' departure, Rudeus makes up his mind after hearing Sara's feelings towards him...!

Rudeus, who had become impotent and let out the feelings he had been harbouring, hit it off with Soldat and later accepts his offer to join him so they began to work together. While staying in the town of Pippin, Rudeus is visited by Elinalise, who was once a member of the same party as Paul, Fangs of the Black Wolf, and she as been traveling with Roxy. She gives Rudeus some information about Zenith.

After receiving a letter of invitation and Hitogami's advice, Rudeus decided to enter Ranoa Magic Academy accompanied by Elinalise where unique students called "Special Students" gather. When he arrives at the university, he faces a mock battle with one of the current students as an exam. His opponent is one of the Special Students named Fitts, who is a chantless magic user like Rudeus.

Rudeus continues his studies at Ranoa Magic Academy as he deepens his relationship with Fitts who joins him on investigating the Teleport Incident. At the Academy, there is also Zanoba who considers Rudeus as a doll figurine master asks to learn how to create them so at the advise of Fitts, they go to the slave market looking for someone they can teach Earth Magic for Zanoba, who is struggling to make dolls because of his Miko strength.

episodes.baslik: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
episodes.wikiTitle: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls
episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 8 Side Story, Chapters 7-8
episodes.ozet: While Zanoba and Julie are progressing in their doll making, Rudeus remembered the Roxy doll that he once made and now in Zanoba's possession. He asked Zanoba where it is, but the doll was in pieces. Zanoba explains that it was destroyed in a duel between the Beast Race Princesses Rinia and Pursena which causes Rudeus to tremble with anger.

The season of love has arrived...!? Rudeus is asked by a special student Cliff to introduce him to a certain woman. On the other hand, duels for courtships is prevalent during the Beast Race mating season in the autumn, so Linia and Pursena, princesses of the Doldia tribe, shut themselves away in the dormitory to avoid duels. However, for some reason, someone appears who challenges Rudeus to a duel...!?

episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 8 Side StoryLight Novel Volume 9 Chapters 5-6
episodes.ozet: Rudeus and Fits investigates the Fittoa Region Teleport Incident. Since their research indicates that teleportation and summoning are similar, Rudeus consults with Silent Seven Star another Special Student, who specializes in summoning magic at Ranoa Magic Academy, in order to gain knowledge about summoning magic. What is the identity of that person?

episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 9 Side Story, Chapters 7-8
episodes.ozet: Rudeus contiues his research on Teleport and Summoning Magic and begins to cooperate with Nanahoshi, who came from the same world as him, even though she was not reincarnated. Fitz feels a strange bond between them, even though he does not know why and begins to feel depressed. However, Rudeus also begins to have feelings for Fitz, even though he is a man.

Rudeus discovers that Fitz is actually a woman. There are also signs that by touching her body that Rudeus would be cured of her impotence. Rudeus finds hope in Fitz's presence, but since she pretends to be a man, he worries that she might become distant. Then Luke comes to visit...

episodes.kaynak:
Light Novel Volume 9 Chapter 11: The Final Push 
Side Story: Sylphiette (Part 0)
Light Novel Volume 10 
Chapter 1: Backing
episodes.ozet: Rudeus finally learns that Fitz is Sylphiette. Sylphy also tells Rudeus about her feelings, and the two are united. Fitts smiles kindly at Rudeus who apologizes for not realizing that she is Sylphy for a long time. Rudeus makes up his mind and visits Ariel with Fitts.

Rudeus is engaged to Sylphy, but he doesn't know the procedure for marriage in this world, so he consults Zanoba and Cliff. When Rudeus hears that his first priority is deciding on a house to live in, he is introduced to a large but cheap property by a real estate agent. It is said to be a haunted property where visitors die mysteriously due to a curse...

In this world, when people get married, they hold a party at their home, so Rudeus prepares for it with Sylphy. And on the day of the party, while Ariel, Zanoba, and other members of Ranoa Magic Academy were in attendance, Elinalise expression seems different than usual. Meanwhile, Rudeus is summoned by Ariel...

Rudeus receives a letter from his father Paul to inform him that he sent Norn and Aisha, his younger sisters to Sharia and to take care of them. Meanwhile, Nanahoshi, who was teleported from the same world as Rudeus to the Human World, continues to research Summoning Magic to return to his original world, but she is becoming increasingly impatient as she cannot complete her research...

episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 10 Chapter 12Light Novel Volume 11 Chapters 1-4
episodes.ozet: Rudeus' younger sisters Norn and Aisha has arrived and begins to stay at the Greyrat House. However, in contrast to the cheerful and energetic Aisha, Norn is shy and withdrawn towards Rudeus... Rudeus, who is at a loss on how to treat his two younger sisters who are complete opposites of each other decides follow Paul's instructions and decides to send them to study at Ranoa Magic Academy, but...

Norn, who started living in the dormitory of Ranoa Magic University, has become a shut-in. Rudeus tries to somehow save Norn by identifying himself with his previous life, and heads to Norn's classroom. Rudeus is shocked by the words he hears from Norn's classmates... Norn, on the other hand, is also worried about how to deal with her older brother Rudeus.

Norn's interaction with Rudeus has improved for the better and has made friends at Ranoa Magic Academy. Rudeus' life with his family and at the academy progresses smoothly. One day, what does Sylphy plan to tell Rudeus...? And what is the content of the letter he receives from a certain person...?

Upon receiving a letter from Geese saying, "Difficulty in rescuing Zenith, seeking help," Rudeus faces the tough choice of leaving behind his pregnant wife, Sylphy, along with his sisters, Norn and Aisha. Despite his inner struggle, Rudeus decides to head to the labyrinth city of Rapan on the Begaritt continent with Elinalise. However, the journey turns out to be even more perilous than he imagined, putting lives at risk.

Upon arriving at the labyrinth city of Rapan, Rudeus and Elinalise quickly find Geese who brings them to Paul and Lilia. Rudeus gently speaks to the exhausted and haggard Paul, who is lamenting he is unable to rescue Zenith. They discuss the conquest of the Teleport Labyrinth where Zenith is supposed to be, but Roxy, who should be there, is nowhere to be found...

episodes.baslik: Magic Circles of the Sixth Stratum
episodes.wikiTitle: Magic Circles of the Sixth Stratum
episodes.yonetim: Akira Nishimori 西森 章, Yasuaki Fujii 藤井康晶
episodes.rez: Tsuji, Sayaka, 辻紗耶佳,, Ryosuke, Shibuya, 渋谷亮介
episodes.ozet: Rudeus, Paul and the other members of the Fangs of the Black Wolf party successfully rescues Roxy, who somehow survives alone in the Teleportation Labyrinth for a whole month so they decide to return to the city of Rapan for Roxy to recover. Although he was concerned about Roxy's occasional aloofness, Rudeus enjoyed reminiscing about the past. Three days later, they once again enter the Teleportation Labyrinth and at an increased progress in conquering each of the floors!

episodes.rez: Chiahe, Chiu, 邱, 家和,, Akiyama, Yasuhiko, 秋山泰彦
episodes.ozet: Rudeus and his friends are transported to the seventh floor and finally see Zenith! However, a giant Manatite Hydra, the guardian of the Teleport Labyrinth, stands in their way. The Hydra is a legendary creature thought to be extinct, a formidable enemy from the Second Human-Demon Wars!

After a fierce battle with the Manatite Hydra, Rudeus and the others rescued Zenith. The price was Rudeus' left arm and Paul's life. Furthermore, Zenith seemed to have lost her memory that causes Rudeus to be fall into regret and despair after the death of his father Paul. Then Roxy approaches him...

episodes.rez: Tomoaki, Takatsudo,, Hiroki, Nagashima,, Ryosuke, Shibuya
episodes.ozet: After six months, Rudeus returns home to where Sylphy and the others are waiting for him. He talks about what happened in the Teleportation Labyrinth, Paul's death, Zenith's condition, and more. He also talks about Roxy... What will Norn, Aisha, and Sylphy's responses be...?

Although Eris is reunited with Rudeus after their battle against Orsted, Eris realizes her own immaturity and decides to leave him. Arriving at the Holy Land of Swords with Ghislaine, Eris declared her intention to defeat the Dragon God Orsted and began training under the Sword God Gal Farion. There, she also meets Nina Farion, a young Sword Saint in training...

episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 9 Extra ChapterLight Novel Volume 10 Side Story
episodes.ozet: Two years have passed since Eris came to the Holy Land of Swords to become a person worthy of Rudeus. Nina, having heard Rudeus' name from Eris, heads to Sharia to confirm his existence. Meanwhile, the Water God Reida and his disciple Isolte arrive at the Holy Land of Swords. Eris, Nina and Isolte end up training together.

Having taken Roxy as his second wife, Rudeus begins a peaceful life with his family, including Sylphiette, their daughter Lucy, his sisters Norn and Aisha, and also returned to Ranoa Magic Academy where Roxy also plans to become a professor at the academy. As Rudeus introduces Roxy to everyone as his wife, Cliff due to being a devout Milis Religion follower, could not accept it...

With the help of Zanoba and Cliff, Rudeus obtained a new left hand, "Zariff's Prosthetic Arm". However, the danger to his family may one day loom again. Driven by the desire to "not lose anyone else," Rudeus continues his research and finally pleads with Roxy to teach him Water King-level Magic.

At the Holy Millis Church, Cliff and Elinalise’s wedding ceremony is held, and Rudeus and his companions shower the couple with blessings. Amidst the celebrations, Rudeus realizes they haven't celebrated Norn and Aisha's tenth birthdays yet. To buy them presents, he hits the town together with Sylphiette and Roxy. And then, at long last, Rudeus's long-cherished wish is finally...

episodes.kaynak: Light Novel Volume 13, Chapter 10Light Novel Volume 14, Extra Chapter
episodes.ozet: When Roxy was hired to escort the Princess of Ranoa, Rudeus decided to tag along. There, they crossed paths with the adventurer party "Amazon Ace", who were assigned to share escort duties—and among them was an unexpected face. It was Sara, former member of Counter Arrow, the adventurer party Rudeus used to travel with…! Rudeus managed to exchange a few words with her, but...

At the graduation ceremony of Ranoa Magic Academy, Linia and Pursena attend as graduates. Nanahoshi dedicates herself to her research on Summoning Magic from other worlds, and Norn is invited to join the student council by Ariel. Those around Rudeus are gradually moving on to their next paths. Amidst all this, Nanahoshi makes a proposal to Rudeus...

In order to find out how Zenith could be healed, Rudeus, through Nanahoshi's introduction, was granted an audience with Armored Dragon King Perugius, one of the three heroes of the Laplace Wars and reside in the floating fortress Chaos Breaker. Exuding an overwhelming presence, Perugius listened to Zenith's story and mentioned the name of an unexpected person.

Nanahoshi suddenly vomits blood and collapses at Chaos Breaker. The cause is Drain Syndrome, an ancient sickness thought to have been eradicated 7,000 years ago. As Nanahoshi fell into despair, Rudeus approaches Perugius, offering to do whatever he could to help her. They then set out to find someone who might know something about Drain Syndrome...

episodes.baslik: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
episodes.wikiTitle: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King
episodes.ozet: In search of a cure for Drain Syndrome, Rudeus and his companions travels to the Demon Continent and found Kishirika. However, they were taken away along with Kishirika by the royal guard of the Immortal Demon King Atoferatofe, who was after her. Rudeus confronts Atoferatofe and is invited to join her royal guard, but...

Rudeus and his friends manage to defeat Atoferatofe and obtained the Sokas Grass, which is said to be effective against Drain Syndrome. Will Nanahoshi's illness be cured...!? Then, on the night Rudeus returns home for the first time in a while, Hitogami appears and gives him some advice. When Rudeus tries to follow that advice, a mysterious person appears...

"I have come from the future." That is what the old man who suddenly appeared tells Rudeus. As Rudeus stands there in bewilderment, the old man speaks of the cruel and tragic events destined to befall him and of the root cause behind them all.

"Consult Nanahoshi. Send a letter to Eris. Be wary of Hitogami, but do not make an enemy of him." These were the words left behind by the Future Rudeus. Rudeus opened the diary entrusted to him by his older self; within its pages lay the harrowing account of the life his future self had lived—a story that began with the death of Roxy.

Having finished reading the diary of his older self, Rudeus takes action to protect his beloved family and avert a tragic future. While keeping the existence and details of his older self a secret from Sylphiette and Roxy, he warns them that their family could be in danger and also speaks of the existence of "Eris."
